items.title: CFTC Takes Oil Trading Oversight ‘Very Seriously,’ Selig Says
items.description: The top US derivatives regulator said Friday that his agency takes market oversight “very seriously” and the agency’s enforcement division has been looking at oil trading during the Iran war.

items.title: India’s RBI Governor Open to Rate Use to Curb Financial Risks
items.description: India’s central bank can deploy interest rates to address financial-stability risks, if needed, said Governor Sanjay Malhotra, in comments that come when analysts expect further pressure on the rupee.

items.description: A NYSE options exchange has suspended trading, causing other exchanges to disregard quotes from the venue.

items.title: US Consumer Sentiment Slips to Five-Month Low on Inflation
items.description: US consumer sentiment edged down to a five-month low in October as high prices and rising interest rates depressed morale.

items.title: Jio’s Record IPO Draws Strong Demand, Defying India Market Rout

items.title: SLB Sees Growth Driven by Middle East Oil Field Recovery
items.description: SLB, the world’s biggest oil field services provider, said it has seen a gradual recovery in its Middle East business despite disruptions from the Iran war.

items.title: Rogers Beats But Stock Falls With SpaceX Ambitions in Focus
items.description: Rogers Communications Inc. beat analyst estimates on higher ticket and advertising revenue from sports, but the company’s core wireless business is still struggling to find growth.

items.title: BASF Increases Bid for Chemicals Rival Evonik to Over €11 Billion
items.description: BASF SE has boosted its takeover offer for German chemicals group Evonik Industries AG to more than €11 billion ($12.3 billion), people familiar with the matter said.

items.title: European Stocks Fall as China Woes Hit Volvo Car, Gucci
items.description: European stocks fell for a second day as disappointing earnings, including from Kering SA’s Gucci, added to concerns over the artificial intelligence trade and elevated oil prices.

items.title: Wheat Slides for Eighth Week in Longest Losing Streak Since 1997
items.description: Wheat futures are on track for the longest weekly slump in almost three decades, marking a stark reversal after the grain led a run-up across agricultural commodities earlier in the year.

items.title: Treasuries’ AI Link Shows Sharp Shift as Haven Trade Returns
items.description: For much of this year, Treasuries offered investors little of their traditional protection when technology stocks stumbled. This week, that role has bounced back sharply.

items.title: Gold Falls to July Low as Inflation Concerns Weigh Before Fed
items.description: Gold fell to the lowest since July as renewed strength in energy prices and weakening US consumer sentiment reinforced inflation concerns just days before the Federal Reserve’s next policy meeting.

items.title: Latest Oil Market News and Analysis for Oct. 23
items.description: Brent oil was trading at the highest level since May as intensifying attacks on Saudi Arabia added to supply concerns already stoked by the US-Iran war.

items.title: Stocks Fall as Oil Rally Keeps a Lid on Treasuries: Markets Wrap
items.description: A resurgence in oil prices dragged down stocks and bonds, stoking concerns about inflation just days ahead of the Federal Reserve decision on interest rates.
